title: At least try one month, it’s worth it.
text: [[VIDEOID:cc5da4fbbae1eeaf24bf8ea42e1f9b09]] This box was a hit with my cats. I couldn’t even get the package all the way open before one of them was stealing the toys inside! I subscribed to this box when it was on a promotion for only $10, so at that price point I couldn’t resist trying it and buying it at least once. I don’t think it’s necessary to get a box every month, at least not for my cats, but in a few months I’ll definitely be ordering another one. If you’re on the fence give it a shot and order one, your cats will not be disappointed!
label: positive
